'''2014 Texas Mini Worlds Day 1 Greg Shaw LS It Is The Future You See (V)''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Greg Shaw]] at [[2014 Texas Mini Worlds]] (Day 1).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[It Is The Future You See (V) (Virtual Block 2)|It Is The Future You See / A Tremor In The Force (V)]]
* '''Username:''' stealtheblind
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
